notes.subject: מקוה
notes.rationale: sampela i tanim 'gat wanpela samting bilong wet' (hope), KJV/JPS 'i no gat man i stap' (abiding) — mi usim 'wait bilong taim'

notes.subject: גרים ותושבים
notes.rationale: tupela tok i go wantaim oltaim long Tanakh — man i no save long ples, na man i stap tasol

notes.subject: samting i pat
notes.rationale: צל i tok long pie bilong diwai o pie bilong man — 'pie' o 'samting i karai' i klia moa long Tok Pisin

translation: Bilong wanem, mipela i ol man i kamap nupela long ples bilong yu, na mipela i stap olsem ol man i stap tasol, olsem olgeta papa bilong mipela; olgeta mon bilong mipela i olsemSDK samting i patlong graun, i no gat wanpela taim bilong wet.

tokens.gloss: ol man i kamap nupela long ples
na mipela i stap olsem ol man i stap tasol
